📄 Open Source Tool of the Week: Stirling PDF

Need to merge, split, compress, convert, redact or reorganize a PDF?

Before uploading that document to some random online service, there's another option.

Stirling PDF is an open-source PDF toolkit you can run yourself, with a huge collection of document tools available through a web interface.

🔓 Your documents. Your infrastructure. Your choice.
